attchmntText: Integrated Filing (Financial) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Ritco Logistics Limited filed its integrated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 43,905.91 lakh rupees. Profit before tax was 561.65 lakh rupees. Net profit attributable to the owner of the company was 404.84 lakh rupees. Earnings per equity share was 1.41 rupees. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 80,417.63 lakh rupees. Profit before tax was 1,253.44 lakh rupees. Net profit attributable to the owner of the company was 955.10 lakh rupees. Earnings per equity share was 3.34 rupees. Subsidiary Trucksup Solutions Private Limited issued 15,65,200 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares aggregating to 78,26,00,000 rupees. The statutory auditors, Mittal and Associates, reviewed the results and reported no material misstatements.

attchmntText: Ritco Logistics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ritco Logistics Limited approved its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The statutory auditor, Mittal and Associates, issued an unmodified opinion on the review. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 80,417.63 lakh, compared to Rs. 71,471.38 lakh in the previous year. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 1,253.44 lakh, down from Rs. 2,700.09 lakh in the corresponding period last year. Net profit attributable to the company was Rs. 955.10 lakh, compared to Rs. 1,984.04 lakh previously. Earnings per share was Rs. 3.34. During the period, subsidiary Trucksup Solutions Private Limited issued 15,65,200 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares aggregating to Rs. 78,26,00,000. The company confirmed no deviation in the utilization of issue proceeds.
